text: Some time in the 1980s, two sirens, Golden and Silver, rise from the sea to a rock band playing on a Polish beach and [follow them back to their nightclub|trigger|an outsider reaches in], where they sing and strip as The Lure. Golden [thirsts for the blood of patrons|wants|feeding on the living], while Silver [falls for the bassist Mietek|trigger|love and desire], who sees only a fish. She trades her tail for legs and loses her voice, knowing that [if he marries another she will turn to sea foam|rules|death on a deadline].
